text:
Noah (Support): FYI escalation from support -> CS: ShadowBox trial is blocked by embedding ingestion failures. Customer onboarding stalled; renewal conversation in 7 days. They see 422s on /embeddings ingest with "`invalid-payload`" after we return vector length mismatch. Can CS pick up comms and offer a short-term workaround? @Sana

Lina (Support Eng): Root log snippet:```
2026-03-23T09:12:02Z WARN embeddings-ingest request_id=rb-77 status=422 error=invalid-payload details=expected_dim=1536 got_dim=1024
2026-03-23T09:12:02Z INFO ingest Preprocess dropped 12 documents due to schema mismatch
```
Also seeing some gzipped payloads arriving truncated from their SDK that cause parse errors.

ops-bot: Alert A-2026-914 created: shadowbox-embed-ingest-blocker (severity: high). Paging: linaj, noahs.

Sana (CS): Thanks — I'll own customer comms. Quick clarifying q: Do we have their SDK version? Could be older client shipping different embedding dim.

Noah (Support): They reported using our python-sdk v0.9.1 (we recommend >=1.1.0). ShadowBox said they upgraded yesterday but still failing.

Diego (Customer Success Manager): Critical: trial ends in 7d and finance has a flagged renewal signal if onboarding not completed. Let's keep execs updated and offer a credit if we delay.

Sana (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate acknowledgement + ETA (30m). 2) Offer a temporary CSV upload route (we can accept precomputed vectors; engineering to expose manual ingest endpoint). 3) Schedule pairing call with their engineers within 4h for SDK/version check. 4) Update renewal tracker ("at risk") and propose 1-week trial extension if unresolved.

Lina (Support Eng): Temporary workaround seems feasible: we can enable a manual ingest endpoint for their tenant to POST precomputed vectors (requires tenant opt-in and quick ACL). I'll open a short-lived ticket to enable it. Also will add a server-side dim-check with a clearer error to avoid 422 confusion.

Noah (Support): Action items: Lina -> enable manual ingest + clearer error (owner); Sana -> send ack and schedule pairing call; Diego -> notify renewal ops + exec blurb; ops-bot -> create temporary ticket for manual endpoint.

ops-bot: Ticket A-2026-914-1 created: manual-ingest-provision for tenant shadowbox (expires in 7d).

Sana (CS): Draft ack I'm about to send: "Hi ShadowBox team — we're aware of embedding ingest errors preventing onboarding. Our engineers are prioritizing a fix and we can enable a temporary manual ingest flow so you can continue. Pairing call scheduled within 4h. CS lead: Sana (sana@redwood.ai)." Comments?

Diego (Customer Success Manager): Looks good. Add a line about trial extension if needed: "If we are unable to complete onboarding before your trial ends, we'll extend your trial by 7 days to ensure proper evaluation."

Sana (CS): Added. Sending now.

Lina (Support Eng): I'll start the manual endpoint enablement and post the provisional curl example here once ready.

Noah (Support): Thanks team. Mateo (oops wrong name) — Diego, can you forward an exec note after pairing call?

Diego (Customer Success Manager): Will do. Marking renewal tracker as "high risk" until ingestion is green.

Sana (CS): Will post updates here after the pairing call and when manual ingest is live. :thumbsup:
